kultivator.guide.c2.tangkis.title: Deflect a monster's attack
kultivator.guide.c2.tangkis.body:
Hold a sword, axe or spear with the off hand empty and right click (or [[key:parry]]) just before a monster's blow lands: the blade turns it, no damage, a burst of sparks.
Too early = hit; tapping all the time narrows the window. Hold right click to guard (less damage, more Posture). Doors and chests still open with right click.
kultivator.guide.c2.postur.title: Posture and the Deathblow
kultivator.guide.c2.postur.body:
Every deflect, clash and guard fills the Posture bar (above the hearts for you, at the top for the opponent). A full bar = Posture Broken: the opponent staggers 1.5 s under the 決 mark.
Strike then for a Deathblow: it cannot be deflected, deals heavy damage, and wins a formal duel at once. Posture recovers when not pressed; low health = slow recovery.
kultivator.guide.c3.duel.title: Your first sword duel
kultivator.guide.c3.duel.body:
Scroll › World › Sword Duel, or /kultivasi duel tantang: pick the opponent, the rules (Free, Handicap, Realm Suppression), the stake. Nobody dies: a duel stops at 10% health.
Left click cuts in the direction the mouse moves, hold for a heavy cut, crouch + click to thrust. Win by the 10% line, a Deathblow, a ring out or a surrender.
Source: Ximen Chuixue and Ye Gucheng on the roofs of the Forbidden City (Gu Long, Juezhan Qianhou): time and place agreed, one cut decides.
kultivator.guide.c3.sempurna.title: The Perfect Deflect
kultivator.guide.c3.sempurna.body:
Deflect within the last 100 milliseconds before the enemy blade lands: a long ring, a golden flash, the world freezes for a moment. The attacker recoils, its Posture climbs, and you get an Opening: your next light cut becomes a riposte.
Perilous attacks marked 危 have their own rules (Golden Core chapter).
kultivator.guide.c4.kunci.title: The Blade Lock
kultivator.guide.c4.kunci.body:
Two heavy cuts (or two crossing cuts) meet: the blades lock. Click left again and again to push; the yin-yang meter slides toward the losing side. Whoever reaches the end wins: the other is pushed back, Posture rises, you get an Opening.
While the opponent pushes hard, press right click or [[key:parry]] for the Sudden Release: they stumble. Wrong timing = you lose the lock.
kultivator.guide.c4.bahaya.title: Perilous attacks: Blade Step and jump
kultivator.guide.c4.bahaya.body: A red 危 appears before a perilous attack. Mountain Cleave (from above): do not guard, deflect. Death Thrust: only a Perfect Deflect, or deflect while moving forward = Blade Step. Low Sweep: jump or evade (crouch while moving, or Combat Roll); a cut in the air afterwards deals more Posture.
kultivator.guide.c6.tonton.title: Watch your disciples duel
kultivator.guide.c6.tonton.body:
Scroll › World › Sword Duel › Watch a duel, or /kultivasi duel murid: two of your disciples duel without stakes and you watch with the spectator camera ([[key:duel_camera]]). In the sect arena idle disciples sit and cheer.
Each disciple has a style: aggressive, defensive, trickster, or patternless like a Sword Saint.
kultivator.guide.c12.duel_tips.title: Common duel mistakes
kultivator.guide.c12.duel_tips.body:
Pressing deflect all the time: the window narrows for 8 ticks and no Perfect Deflect. Wait for the blade.
Attacking while the opponent charges a heavy cut: it wins the clash. Deflect, then answer in the Opening.
Guarding forever: Posture fills and the guard breaks. Light cuts from too far: they whiff and recover slower.
With Better Combat dual wielding, right click stays the off-hand attack; bind [[key:parry]] to a mouse side button or C.
